SEA LIVE Ads delivered exceptional business growth in H1, with overall LIVE Take Rate increasing from 3.6% to 4.8%, while Merchant LIVE Take Rate grew even faster from 5.9% to 8.0%. 
Unlike traditional eCommerce ads, LIVE commerce requires fundamentally different solutions across advertiser adoption, customer behavior, traffic allocation, and monetization optimization due to its highly dynamic and real-time nature.
This growth was driven by four strategic pillars jointly delivered by the e-Commerce and Shop Ads organizations.
expanded LIVE GMax penetration through a combination of product innovation and ecosystem collaboration. Initiatives including Dynamic Commissions, LIVE Bundle, LIVE Mission, and joint key-account penetration programs with eCommerce Operations enabled substantially more merchants to adopt LIVE advertising at scale.
successfully transformed advertiser behavior to improve campaign quality and budget efficiency. Through Auto-Budget adoption, Creative Exploration optimization, and LIVE Ads Diagnosis enhancements, budget hit rates decreased from 30% to 25%, increased Video-to-LIVE creative supply among top advertisers, and extended LIVE advertising duration, creating a healthier and more sustainable monetization model.
maximized major commerce moments by launching programs such as the KLS Accelerator Program, enabling top advertisers to capitalize on Double Day and Payday campaigns with significant LIVE GMV acceleration during peak shopping events.
continuously optimized monetization efficiency through bidding strategy upgrades, automation capabilities, traffic allocation improvements, and Hybrid Lift optimization, further improving delivery efficiency and Take Rate.
Together, these initiatives addressed critical bottlenecks across the entire LIVE advertising ecosystem, from merchant activation and campaign adoption to traffic optimization and monetization efficiency, creating a scalable growth engine for LIVE Ads. Beyond delivering substantial Take Rate improvements in H1, the program established a stronger long-term foundation for sustainable LIVE commerce growth across global markets.
